subject: 义县万佛堂石窟 · 西区第六窟交脚弥勒大佛正面
name: 义县万佛堂石窟
sub: 西区第六窟 · 交脚弥勒大佛
yearNote: 西区凿于北魏太和二十三年（499），以元景造像碑为据；东区景明三年（502）另记。第六窟前壁早已崩塌，大像露天，身躯经近世修补，头光现存彩绘为后世重妆（1930年代《亚细亚大观》图说已记“近世修缮”）。年份取开凿年，不代表现存修补层。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q2548196（万佛堂石窟 Wanfotang Grottoes）P625 坐标 41.576031, 121.159115，石窟区近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点复用既有 yixian（义县）。
lede: 大凌河北岸的崖壁上，北魏太和二十三年（499）营州刺史元景发愿开凿西区，景明三年（502）韩贞等续凿东区，是东北年代最早、规模最大的石窟。西区第六窟前壁早已坍塌，三米余高的交脚弥勒露天而坐，头后一轮莲瓣与化佛环绕的大背光仍留着颜色。
facts: 年代：西区北魏太和二十三年（499）开凿，有元景造像碑；东区景明三年（502）有韩贞等造窟题记。现存洞窟十六个、造像近五百尊，1988年列第三批国保。
形制：第六窟主像为交脚弥勒，像高3.05米，是北方与中原石窟中最大的佛装弥勒像；前壁崩塌后成露天大佛，背光刻莲瓣、化佛与缠枝纹。
图版：以2015年正面实拍定头光与龛形，身躯轮廓参照1930年代《亚细亚大观》旧照；现代披袍、香炉、供桌与说明牌去除，背光彩绘只取轮廓线。
caption: 义县万佛堂石窟 · 第六窟交脚弥勒
北魏 · 499
structure_checkpoints: 龛形：浅弧形露天大龛，龛顶为天然岩面，左右岩壁向前略收；像座为近代砌筑的方形台座（2015年照片中被红布覆盖）。
主像：单尊交脚弥勒，正面端坐，双脚于踝部交叉下垂（1930年代旧照可见），头部略向前倾，面部为北魏修长脸型，肉髻低平，双手置于腿上。
背光：一轮大圆形头光加外圈莲瓣与火焰状缠枝纹，外圈嵌一圈圆形化佛小龛（正面可数约十一至十二个）；头光内有同心圆带纹。
两侧：右侧岩壁有一尊较小的立像与数个小龛（2015年照片右下可见一尊立姿残像），左侧为残损岩面；图版只画主像与背光，次要残龛保留轮廓即可。
身躯：2015年照片身躯被红色披袍遮住，须以1930年代旧照为准——衣褶简化，台座为素面方台；旧照龛前的砖房与护栏不入图。
material_observations: 崖壁为灰褐色砂岩，表面多孔风化；主像石质灰色，面部经修补略光滑；背光保留后世彩绘（土红、靛蓝、白），莲瓣白地红线；台座为灰色水泥与石砌；红布披袍、黄色供香、黑色铜钵为现代物。
author: 猫猫的日记本

additional_sources.role: 1930年代露天大佛旧照，提供披袍下的身躯、双手与交脚姿态；图说记“第六窟前方全部崩坏，大坐像露出，台座与全身经近世修缮”。

source_note: 主图为猫猫的日记本 2015 年 9 月实拍（CC BY-SA 4.0），Commons 文件说明为“义县万佛堂石窟，第六窟，交脚弥勒佛像正面”；主像身躯被现代红布披袍遮住，故以 1930 年代《亚细亚大观》第 11 辑 051 图（公有领域）核对身躯、双手与交脚。两图均为正面，线稿按主图构图、旧照补形。

Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: Cave 6 of the Wanfotang Grottoes, Yi County, Liaoning: a single large seated cross-ankled Maitreya (Northern Wei, 499) in an open, collapsed-front rock niche. Image 2 (2015 colour photo) gives the niche shape, the big circular halo with its outer ring of small Buddha roundels and flame-scroll border, the head, and the right-hand small standing attendant figure. Image 3 (1930s black-and-white photo) shows the same statue WITHOUT the modern red cloth: use it for the torso, the two hands resting on the thighs, the ankles crossed and hanging down, and the plain block pedestal. Draw the statue uncovered as in Image 3, with the halo as in Image 2. Keep the rough natural rock outline of the niche around the figure as a loose contour. Remove the red cloth, incense sticks, bowl, offering table, the modern plaque and the brick hut of the old photo. Portrait 1024×1536, statue and halo centred, pedestal base and top of halo uncut.
